To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the enzymatic synthesis of GDP-fucose is possible and that GDP-fucose pyro-phosphorylase from porcine salivary gland is a suitable enzyme for this reaction.
we have developed a preparative enzymatic method for the conversion of fucose into s-L-fuctose-1-phosphate and its conversion into GDP-fucosyl.
we have developed a new, efficient, and simple method for the enzymatic synthesis of fucose-1- phosphate and GDP-fucose.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the synthesis of the two important precursors s-L-fucose and GDP-fucose.
the development of an enzymatic route for the preparation of fucose-1-6-phosphate and GDP-fucose.
the enzymatic synthesis of fucose-containing glycoconjugates.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
enzymatic synthesis of GDP‐fucose is possible but that the yield is low.
the enzymatic synthesis of GDP-fucose from fucose is a feasible process.
the enzymatic synthesis of GDP-fucose can be achieved in high yields, if the enzymes are enclosed in a dialyzing bag, and the inhibitor ADP is removed by cofactor regenerations.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the enzymes are able to synthesize GDP-fucose from fucose in a preparative scale.
the enzymatic synthesis of GDP-fucose is possible, but that the yields are not yet sufficient for preparative purposes.
fucose is an easily available starting material for the synthesis of GDP-fucose, a key intermediate in the biosynthesis of complex heterooligomers.
The main takeaway from our work is that
it is possible to synthesize s-L-fucose 1-phosphate and GDP-fucose by the use of enzymes.
enzymatic synthesis of GDP-fucose can be carried out on a preparative scale.
enzymatic methods can be applied to synthesize s-L-fucose‐1‐ phosphate in good yields.
